Every situation

A quest creature attacking you

Timberling Ravager: elite, three levels above you, needed for your quest, and it is after you. The most urgent tooltip there is.

The same wolf, your whole party on the quest

You 3/8, Jokke 5/8, Thalianne 8/8, Mira 1/8, Brokk 6/8. Glance shows a small bar each, the Ledger a short table.

Tapped by someone else

Another player hit it first, so it is no use to you. Everything goes grey.

A rare, below your level

Silver frame and wing for a rare, a grey level because it is far below you.

A boss whose health the game hides

A skull for the level and a red frame. The bar fills from the game, and the game writes the percentage itself.

A friendly NPC

No health bar: an innkeeper will not lose any. Role and services instead, and the title drops out of the name.

A party member in another zone

Class colour, guild, faction and where he is. Hovered on the party frame, so the Banner falls back to Glance.

An enemy player, flagged for PvP

An Alliance rogue: class colour on the edge, the PvP flag, guild and faction, and the red glow because he is after you.

Width, height and the bar

Each look has its own width and height (60% to 160%). The bar has five textures and three colours; Slate and By health are the defaults.

Defaults shown: Glance is the everyday look, holding Shift shows the Ledger, and the Ledger shrinks to Glance in combat. Every field is on in every look; each look's fields, width and height can be changed in the options (/kt). The level's colour says how hard a creature is, as the game's own colours: grey trivial, green easy, yellow even, orange hard, red very hard.
